meaning:
Chisloth-tabor = "flanks of Tabor"
a town of Issachar on the slopes of Mount Tabor; also 'Chesulloth' ke.sul.lot (כְּסֻלּוֹת "Chesulloth" H3694)
Another name of ke.sul.lot (כְּסֻלּוֹת "Chesulloth" H3694)

elsewhere.note: It turned from Sarid eastward toward the sunrise to the border of Chisloth Tabor. It went out to Daberath, and went up to Japhia.
